# Naman Parikh

> I build agent-native software: tools that agents use, built with agents, that improve themselves.

## Projects

- [AgentDial](https://github.com/naman10parikh/agentdial): One identity for any agent across SMS, voice, email and chat apps.
- [WikiMem](https://github.com/naman10parikh/wikimem): Self-improving memory for agents: ingest anything, query everything.
- [Skillsmith](https://github.com/naman10parikh/skillsmith): Create, test and vet SKILL.md skills for any coding agent.
- [Agent Booster](https://github.com/naman10parikh/agent-booster): Mechanical code edits without a model: deterministic, free, offline.
- [Hooksmith](https://github.com/naman10parikh/hooksmith): Generate, lint and fire-test lifecycle hooks for coding agents.
- [AgentCast](https://github.com/naman10parikh/agentcast): A library of reusable sub-agent personas, validated and scored.
- [Plugsmith](https://github.com/naman10parikh/plugsmith): Turn any repository into a Claude Code plugin and marketplace.
- [Armory](https://github.com/naman10parikh/armory): Where agents gear up: 60,000+ open-source agent components, ranked on public evidence.
- [AgentGrid](https://github.com/naman10parikh/agentgrid): Spawn grids of coding agents (Claude, Codex, Gemini, Cursor) in one command.
- [AgentSwarm](https://github.com/naman10parikh/agentswarm): One YAML file, a swarm of expert agents, no idle panes.
- [AgentBench](https://github.com/naman10parikh/agentbench): Lighthouse for coding-agent harnesses: score your setup out of 100.
- [AgentMoney](https://github.com/naman10parikh/agentmoney): Know what your AI costs: pricing and spend for Claude, GPT and Gemini.
- [Sandforge](https://github.com/naman10parikh/sandforge): Sandbox templates with a trust envelope, validated and booted in E2B.
- [Claude Harness](https://github.com/naman10parikh/claude-harness): One command installs a tested Claude Code harness: skills, hooks, rules, sub-agents and memory.
- [Pixel](https://github.com/naman10parikh/pixel): Frontend taste you can put in CI: it scaffolds Next.js 16 apps and blocks UI that looks AI-made.
- [Pebble](https://github.com/naman10parikh/pebble): Ships React Native and Expo apps headlessly: shape call, scaffold, EAS build, OTA and store review.
- [Turbo](https://github.com/naman10parikh/turbo): Turns an OpenAPI spec into a strict TypeScript Hono service and audits it for production bugs.
- [Acorn](https://github.com/naman10parikh/acorn): Designs Postgres schemas, makes migrations safe to run and tests row-level security so tenants stay apart.
- [Badge](https://github.com/naman10parikh/badge): Auth and agent identity, proven rather than assumed.
- [Penny](https://github.com/naman10parikh/penny): Payments and billing wired correctly, for products and their agents.
- [Rocket](https://github.com/naman10parikh/rocket): Release engineering you can put in CI.
- [Hush](https://github.com/naman10parikh/hush): Keeps secrets from reaching the model: blocked at the hook, scanned, and encrypted with SOPS and age.
- [Canary](https://github.com/naman10parikh/canary): Error and uptime monitoring on OpenTelemetry, with burn-rate alerts and proof the page gets delivered.
- [Tally](https://github.com/naman10parikh/tally): Product analytics, feature flags and A/B tests that fail closed, starting from a CI-gated tracking plan.
- [Pigeon](https://github.com/naman10parikh/pigeon): Transactional email that reaches the inbox: authenticated, kept apart from marketing mail, easy to unsubscribe.
- [Bee](https://github.com/naman10parikh/bee): Background jobs and webhooks that are safe to run twice: every side effect happens once.
- [Shelf](https://github.com/naman10parikh/shelf): File uploads and object storage: presigned, validated, cheap to serve.
- [Echo](https://github.com/naman10parikh/echo): Rate limits and caching for serverless APIs.
- [Truffle](https://github.com/naman10parikh/truffle): Search you can measure: hybrid ranking with a relevance loop.
- [Stamp](https://github.com/naman10parikh/stamp): SOC 2 readiness you can run: gap reports, audit trails and the SSO plan.
- [Parrot](https://github.com/naman10parikh/parrot): Localisation for Next.js, checked in CI: plurals, right-to-left and search engines.
- [Awesome A2A Servers](https://github.com/naman10parikh/awesome-a2a-servers): A curated list of Agent2Agent (A2A) protocol servers, clients, libraries and tutorials.
- [Svgforge](https://github.com/naman10parikh/svgforge): Diagrams as code: deterministic SVG figures with lint gates, drawn by agents.
- [Fleet Audit](https://github.com/naman10parikh/fleet-audit): Scan your repositories for every surface coding agents need, and fix them.
- [Agent Entity Checklist](https://github.com/naman10parikh/agent-entity): Everything an agent entity needs, in 16 categories, each with a pick.

## For agents

- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): how to choose and install a project
- [Marketplace](.claude-plugin/marketplace.json): every project as a Claude Code plugin
